verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork marketing says its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence "on your schedule", which implies user-defined recurring evidence-collection jobs. That is the only evidence and it is a thin marketing claim. The fixed once-a-day code scan is a product-set cadence plus manual one-off scans, not a schedule the user configures, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable schedules (cron/interval settings), scheduling of arbitrary workflows beyond evidence collection, API/MCP-accessible schedule management, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
